name: aiseewhy
description: Check whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini crawlers can reach and read a page, find the firewall or robots.txt rule that blocks them, apply the fix and prove it worked. Falls back to the public API or a local read-only check when the MCP server is not connected. Also crawls the whole site for classic SEO problems, and checks product and local business structured data.
